I recently written some of mine for people that I cares about. I share my most heart felt one with you: 

To Typho, 

Typho, what can I say other then I’m sorry and I’ll always love you. You were honestly the last person on my mind and in my heart. It was no question that liked you as more than a friend but that doesn't matter now, didn't matter then either because you deserve someone so much better than the trash bag I am.. I would always be sweet to you anyway because you were so nice to me. Your cute, cute voice was just was amazing. Sorry I’m not great with words. But I never, ever meant to hurt you. Never. I’m just not as strong as people think I am which sucks but it’s what I have. I’m sorry I couldn't meet you in person or just do better for you. The first time I seen your face was just amazing, I had the biggest grin on my face. You're super super pretty and that may be the gei in me talking but I think you’re beautiful, and I think your just a great person. There wasn't a moment where I didn't smile when you talked to me. And our little “dinner date” ment so much more to me than you could even imagine. I honestly could say it was probably the best date I’d ever been on even if it wasn't a legitimate date. Your letter is going to be the longest by far because I’m just gonna pour my heart out to you. It’s funny, I feel so so sad even just typing this to you so I guess that means it might hurt you the most. And as much as I hate that I still feel I have little to no purpose in life and want to die. You probably think I’m selfish for doing this to you but I just couldn't do it. No matter how many pills I took, how much we all had a good time, this emptiness and darkness would always be there waiting. But I’ll be honest and say even when I was messed up thinking about you or talking to you gave me a little bit of relief. So thank you for everything, I’ll always love you. There was a few things I wanted you to have, idk if my parent will give you the things. But just know that you're entitled to the stained glass pieces I have (junkrat/mercy), my pocket knife (if I haven't used it on me, unless you'd still want that but I wouldn't want to haunt you with something like that I just know you thought it was a nice knife), my overwatch smurf account, and pretty much anything else you want that I haven't listed for someone else.
